question: A 16-year-old boy presents to the emergency room with severe right shoulder pain following a painful overhead swing during a competitive volleyball match. On physical examination, the patient has limited active range of motion of the right shoulder and significant pain with passive motion. Suspecting a rotator cuff injury, the physician obtains an MRI, which indicates a minor tear in the tendon of the rotator cuff muscle that is innervated by the axillary nerve. Which of the following muscles was affected?
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Axillary nerve innervation" -> "Teres minor innervated by axillary nerve" -> "MRI shows minor tear in tendon" -> "Teres minor affected" -> 95%
CHAIN: "Rotator cuff injury" -> "MRI confirms tendon tear" -> "Axillary nerve involvement" -> "Teres minor is innervated by axillary nerve" -> "Teres minor is the affected muscle" -> 95%

CHAIN: "Shoulder pain during overhead swing" -> "Suspected rotator cuff injury" -> "MRI indicates tendon tear" -> "Axillary nerve innervates Teres minor" -> "Teres minor is the affected muscle" -> 95%

CHAIN: "Painful overhead swing" -> "Limited shoulder motion" -> "MRI shows rotator cuff tendon tear" -> "Tendon tear in muscle innervated by axillary nerve" -> "Teres minor innervated by axillary nerve" -> "Teres minor is the affected muscle" -> 95%

CHAIN: "Competitive volleyball injury" -> "Severe right shoulder pain" -> "MRI reveals minor tendon tear" -> "Involvement of axillary nerve" -> "Teres minor innervated by axillary nerve" -> "Teres minor is the affected muscle" -> 95%
analysis: The axillary nerve innervates the deltoid and teres minor muscles. Given the MRI findings of a minor tear in the tendon of a rotator cuff muscle innervated by the axillary nerve, the affected muscle is the teres minor. The other muscles listed (infraspinatus, subscapularis, supraspinatus, and teres major) are innervated by different nerves.
